title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Lease-End Accounting: Figuring the Closed-End Excess Mileage Charge
content:
# Lease-End Accounting Note — Excess Mileage Charge, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Calculation.** For a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease:

1. The miles driven are the turn-in odometer less the odometer at delivery.
2. The miles over are the miles driven less the mileage allowance earned, never below zero.
3. The mileage allowance earned is the annual mileage allowance multiplied by the months in service and divided by 12.
4. The class rate is the rate for the unit's vehicle class in the closed-end excess mileage rate table: $0.25 a mile for a light-duty pickup, cargo van, passenger van or SUV, $0.20 a mile for a sedan and $0.35 a mile for a medium-duty chassis.
5. The excess mileage charge is the priced amount, the miles over multiplied by the class rate, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Order of figuring.** The quantities are figured in this order — first the miles over, then the per-mile rate, then the priced amount — and whatever acts on one of them acts on it at that point; the charge is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Records used

| Quantity | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Odometer at delivery, annual mileage allowance, months in service, vehicle class | the unit's schedule |
| Turn-in odometer | the unit's record of its turn-in or recovery |

## Class rates

| Vehicle class | Class rate per mile |
|---|---|
| Light-duty pickup, cargo van, passenger van, SUV | $0.25 |
| Sedan | $0.20 |
| Medium-duty chassis | $0.35 |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A sedan with an odometer at delivery of 1200, a turn-in odometer of 52700, an annual mileage allowance of 24000 and 20 months in service.

| Step | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Miles driven | 52700 less 1200 | 51500 |
| Allowance earned | 24000 multiplied by 20, divided by 12 | 40000 |
| Miles over | 51500 less 40000 | 11500 |
| Class rate | sedan | $0.20 |
| Charge | 11500 multiplied by 0.20 | 2300.00 |

Had the turn-in odometer been 40000 or lower, the miles driven would not exceed the allowance, the miles over would be zero and the charge 0.00.
